_readme: Folder-id lookup for scripts/acquire/banglavegnet.py. Filling these in is a ONE-TIME MANUAL STEP (see ml/data/DATASET_AUDIT_v0.md, 'BanglaVegNet acquisition status', for exactly why) - everything downstream of it (listing, downloading, validating, grouping, provenance) is fully scripted and idempotent. To fill in a class: open https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/rtx9ngb68j/2/files in a browser, open DevTools > Network, filter on 'files?version=2', click into that vegetable's folder in the file browser, and copy the 'folder_id' query parameter (a UUID) from the request that fires. Each class has exactly TWO folders (raw originals, several MB per file; processed/compressed, ~10-15KB per file) - copy the RAW one only, per the 'prefer raw, skip processed derivatives' instruction this script follows. A still-null folder_id_raw means that class is skipped (never guessed, never left silently empty in a way that looks like 'acquired').
